code:
use default
use IO.Std.read_line
use System.Random
use System.StringSplitOptions.REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES

let random = Random(9)

let mills = [
    ["a7", "d7", "g7"], ["b6", "d6", "f6"], ["c5", "d5", "e5"],
    ["a4", "b4", "c4"], ["e4", "f4", "g4"], ["c3", "d3", "e3"],
    ["b2", "d2", "f2"], ["a1", "d1", "g1"],
    ["a1", "a4", "a7"], ["b2", "b4", "b6"], ["c3", "c4", "c5"],
    ["d1", "d2", "d3"], ["d5", "d6", "d7"], ["e3", "e4", "e5"],
    ["f2", "f4", "f6"], ["g1", "g4", "g7"]
]

let board = MAP[string, char]()
let neighbours = MAP[string, LIST[string]]()

for mill in mills do
    for point in mill do
        board[point] = '.'

        if !neighbours.contains_key(point) then
            neighbours[point] = LIST[string]()
        fi
    od

    for i in 0..2 do
        neighbours[mill[i]].add(mill[i + 1])
        neighbours[mill[i + 1]].add(mill[i])
    od
od

let template = [
    "7 *-----------*-----------*",
    "  |           |           |",
    "6 |   *-------*-------*   |",
    "  |   |       |       |   |",
    "5 |   |   *---*---*   |   |",
    "  |   |   |       |   |   |",
    "4 *---*---*       *---*---*",
    "  |   |   |       |   |   |",
    "3 |   |   *---*---*   |   |",
    "  |   |       |       |   |",
    "2 |   *-------*-------*   |",
    "  |           |           |",
    "1 *-----------*-----------*",
    "  a   b   c   d   e   f   g"
]

show() is
    for row in 0..template.count do
        let rank = 7 - row / 2

        write_line(
            (0..template[row].length)
                |> map(column =>
                    if template[row][column] == '*' then
                        board["{"abcdefg"[(column - 2) / 4]}{rank}"]
                    else
                        template[row][column]
                    fi)
                |> join(""))
    od
si

let to_place = MAP[char, int]()
to_place['W'] = 9
to_place['B'] = 9

other(side: char) -> char => if side == 'W' then 'B' else 'W' fi

holding(side: char) -> List[string] =>
    board.keys |> filter(p => board[p] == side) |> collect_list()

count_of(side: char) -> int => holding(side).count

in_mill(point: string, side: char) -> bool =>
    mills |> any(m =>
        m |> any(p => p =~ point) /\ m |> all(p => board[p] == side))

use Move = (from: string?, to: string)

moves(side: char) -> List[Move] is
    let empty = holding('.')

    if to_place[side] > 0 then
        return
            empty
                |> map(p => (from = cast string?(null), to = p))
                |> collect_list()
    fi

    let flying = count_of(side) == 3
    let result = LIST[Move]()

    for from in holding(side) do
        let targets =
            if flying then empty
            else neighbours[from] |> filter(p => board[p] == '.')
            fi

        for to in targets do
            result.add((from = from, to = to))
        od
    od

    result
si

play(move: Move, side: char) is
    if let from = move.from then
        board[from] = '.'
    else
        to_place[side] = to_place[side] - 1
    fi

    board[move.to] = side
si

undo(move: Move, side: char) is
    board[move.to] = '.'

    if let from = move.from then
        board[from] = side
    else
        to_place[side] = to_place[side] + 1
    fi
si

makes_mill(move: Move, side: char) -> bool is
    play(move, side)
    let made = in_mill(move.to, side)
    undo(move, side)
    made
si

removable(side: char) -> List[string] is
    let pieces = holding(side)
    let loose = pieces |> filter(p => !in_mill(p, side)) |> collect_list()

    if loose.count > 0 then loose else pieces fi
si

pick[T](items: List[T]) -> T => items[random.next(items.count)]

computer_move(side: char) -> Move is
    let legal = moves(side)
    let winning =
        legal |> filter(m => makes_mill(m, side)) |> collect_list()

    if winning.count > 0 then
        return pick(winning)
    fi

    let threats =
        moves(other(side))
            |> filter(m => makes_mill(m, other(side)))
            |> map(m => m.to)
            |> collect_list()

    let blocking =
        legal
            |> filter(m => threats |> any(t => t =~ m.to))
            |> collect_list()

    if blocking.count > 0 then pick(blocking) else pick(legal) fi
si

let autopilot mut = false

ask(prompt: string) -> string? is
    if autopilot then
        return null
    fi

    write_line(prompt)

    let line = read_line()

    if !line? then
        autopilot = true
        write_line("(no more input, so your moves are chosen for you)")
        return null
    fi

    write_line("> {line}")
    line.trim().to_lower()
si

human_move() -> Move? is
    let legal = moves('W')
    let placing = to_place['W'] > 0

    while true do
        let answer =
            ask(
                if placing then "where do you place a piece?"
                else "which piece do you move, and where to?"
                fi)

        if !answer? then
            return null
        fi

        let squares =
            answer
                .replace("-", " ")
                .split([' '], REMOVE_EMPTY_ENTRIES)

        let chosen =
            legal
                |> filter(m =>
                    if placing then
                        squares.count == 1 /\ m.to =~ squares[0]
                    else
                        squares.count == 2 /\
                        m.from =~ squares[0] /\ m.to =~ squares[1]
                    fi)
                |> first()

        if let move = chosen then
            return move
        fi

        write_line("that is not a legal move")
    od

    return null
si

human_removal(options: List[string]) -> string? is
    while true do
        let answer = ask("which of the computer's pieces do you remove?")

        if !answer? then
            return null
        fi

        if options |> any(o => o =~ answer) then
            return answer
        fi

        write_line("choose one of {options |> join(", ")}")
    od

    return null
si

acts(side: char, yours: string, theirs: string) -> string =>
    if side == 'W' then "you {yours}" else "the computer {theirs}" fi

describe(move: Move, side: char) -> string =>
    if let from = move.from then
        "{acts(side, "move", "moves")} {from}-{move.to}"
    else
        "{acts(side, "place", "places")} a piece on {move.to}"
    fi

let side mut = 'W'
let winner: char? mut = null

write_line("you are W and move first; the computer is B")

while !winner? do
    let legal = moves(side)

    if legal.count == 0 then
        write_line("{acts(side, "cannot", "cannot")} move")
        winner = other(side)
        break
    fi

    if side == 'W' /\ !autopilot then
        show()
    fi

    let move =
        if side == 'W' then human_move() ?? computer_move(side)
        else computer_move(side)
        fi

    play(move, side)
    write_line(describe(move, side))

    if in_mill(move.to, side) then
        let options = removable(other(side))

        let taken =
            if side == 'W' then human_removal(options) ?? pick(options)
            else pick(options)
            fi

        board[taken] = '.'
        let removes = acts(side, "remove", "removes")
        write_line("  a mill: {removes} the piece on {taken}")
    fi

    if to_place[other(side)] == 0 /\ count_of(other(side)) < 3 then
        winner = side
    fi

    side = other(side)
od

show()
write_line(acts(winner!, "win", "wins"))
